module: Data module for genericGauges: provides for each wheel a temperature color (fixed value) and the tire pressure.
notes: The temperatures are constant "#ffffff" colors (no real temperature is computed in this file).
Pressure = max((pressure group pressure - ambient pressure) * 0.001, 0); 0 if the wheel has no pressure group.

updateGFX.desc: Does nothing (the update is done by updateGaugeData).

setupGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges with the properties requested in displayData.customModules: temperatures (table wheelName -> "#ffffff") and pressures (table wheelName -> pressure).

properties.desc: Set of requested properties (key = name, value = true).

updateGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges before each send: fills moduleData with the requested values.

moduleData.desc: Module data table, then sent to the HTML page.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the last send (s).
